project_context: News/AI Hybrid Web App prioritizing truth, deep analysis, and extreme accessibility for non-technical users. Interface in IT/EN.

global_rules.theme_mode: System default with user toggle (Light/Dark). Light mode resembles a high-end broadsheet paper. Dark mode resembles a digital intelligence archive.
global_rules.border_strategy: Cardless layout. Use 1px solid borders (`border-border`) to separate content like newspaper columns. NO floating cards with drop shadows.
global_rules.accessibility_focus: Extreme. Minimum 48x48px tap targets. Large default fonts. High contrast. Zero confusing icons without text labels.

headings.usage: Article headlines, page titles, and AI analysis titles. Evokes trust, objectivity, and classic journalism.

body.usage: UI elements, topic tags, meta information, and AI query input. Very friendly, clear, and legible.

colors.usage_rules: NO gradients. Use solid colors. The 'accent_red' is used EXCLUSIVELY for the 'Approfondisci' (Deep Dive) action, breaking news, or active selection states to immediately guide non-tech users.

layouts.app_shell: Top Navigation bar featuring an extra-large, prominent AI Query Input (looks like a search bar: 'Chiedi all\'AI un argomento...'). Left sidebar (desktop) or bottom nav (mobile) for Categories, Saved, Profile.
layouts.news_feed: The 'Editorial Grid'. Not a boring list. The top news item spans full width (col-span-full) with a huge image. Followed by a masonry or 2/3-column grid. Items separated by sharp 1px borders.
layouts.spacing: Highly generous. Use `p-6` or `p-8` inside article containers to give text room to breathe.

AI_Query_Bar.design: Large pill-shaped input field in the header. Must look instantly usable. Icon on the left (Search), large text placeholder. Prominent 'Invia' (Send) button.
AI_Query_Bar.interaction: Focusing on the bar dims the background slightly to emphasize the search/ask functionality.

News_Item.design: Flat, cardless. Image has `rounded-sm` or no rounding. Meta data (Date, Category) in uppercase above the title. Large serif title. Short sans-serif excerpt.
News_Item.actions: Primary button: 'Approfondisci' (Deep Dive) in Accent Red. Secondary action: 'Salva' (Save).

Deep_Dive_Panel.design: Shadcn Sheet (Side drawer). When 'Approfondisci' is clicked, it slides in. Contains AI-generated structured points: 'I veri motivi' (Real reasons), 'Dati' (Data), 'Contesto' (Context).
Deep_Dive_Panel.style: Structured like an executive summary. Large text, heavily scannable by older/non-tech users.

Topic_Selector.design: Large, highly visible tappable pill buttons. When selected, they invert (dark background, light text) indicating active state.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text links get a 1px underline. Images zoom very slightly (scale 1.02) inside a hidden overflow container.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Keep transitions fast (150ms). Non-tech users prefer snappy, predictable interfaces over sluggish animations.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Default text must be large (base text-lg).
accessibility.language: UI must support simple IT/EN toggling. Interface labels default to Italian and must be literal (e.g., 'Esci' instead of just a door icon).

media.image_style: Editorial, objective, wide shots. Avoid generic stock smiles. Use architectural, data, or environmental imagery for categories.

critical_rules: PROJECT USES .JS and .JSX EXTENSIONS, NOT .TSX. Ensure all generated components and configurations are JavaScript compatible.
DO NOT use generic purple AI gradients. This is a serious news platform, not a tech startup.
DO NOT use floating cards with soft shadows. Use a 'cardless' layout with 1px solid borders (`border-border`) for separation.
Ensure text sizes are larger than typical defaults for extreme readability (base should be `text-lg`).
The 'Approfondisci' feature must open an AI analysis view (Sheet or Dialog) that breaks down the real reasons and data clearly.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or strict column-based grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text must flow naturally left-aligned for reading.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡). Use sleek icons from `lucide-react` instead.
Use sonner for toasts, located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` or `.js`.
